description: Figure 7 (right) is a grouped bar chart illustrating CoLeG-R performance across different LLaMA-2 model scales under four supervised fine-tuning (SFT) conditions. The horizontal axis lists the model categories LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B (left to right), and the vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-R (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals. For each model category, four adjacent bars are shown with a legend indicating: “no SFT” (blue), “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink). For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars are approximately 67% (blue), 66% (light orange), 78% (light purple), and 82% (pink). For LLaMA-2-13B, the bars are approximately 68% (blue), 72% (light orange), 82% (light purple), and 78% (pink). For LLaMA-2-70B, the bars are approximately 78% (blue), 80% (light orange), 81% (light purple), and 83% (pink). The bars are not presented as a sorted ranking; they are grouped by model size, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors and the legend.
